title: Tarawih prayer – worship in Ramadan
intro: Twenty rak‘ahs on the nights of Ramadan, after Isha and before witr.

learn.html: Tarawih is the prayer we pray on the nights of the month of Ramadan.
Praying tarawih is a confirmed sunnah (mu’akkadah), and it is best to pray it in the masjid behind the imam.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “Whoever stays up Ramadan in prayer, believing and hoping for Allah’s reward, his sins will be forgiven.” (Bukhari)
Tarawih is prayed at the time of Isha, after the last sunnah of Isha and before witr. It has twenty rak‘ahs, and we give salam after every four or after every two rak‘ahs.

items: If we give salam after every four rak‘ahs, tarawih is prayed like the first sunnah of Isha.
If we pray it two rak‘ahs at a time, it is prayed like the last sunnah of Isha.
After the salam, it is good to take a short break, with dhikr or salawat.

learn.label: Niyyah for tarawih
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ التَّرَاوِيحِ عِشْرِينَ رَكْعَةً، أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اقْتَدَيْتُ بِهَذَا الْإِمَامِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaatat-taraaweehi ‘ishreena rak‘atan, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati, iqtadaytu bihaadhal-imaami. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the tarawih prayer of twenty rak‘ahs, on time, facing the Qiblah, following this imam. Allah is the Greatest!

learn.text: Four rak‘ahs of tarawih – like the first sunnah of Isha

items: 1st rak‘ah: Subhanaka, A‘udhu, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
2nd rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
First sitting: At-Tahiyyat and the salawat
3rd rak‘ah: Subhanaka, A‘udhu, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
4th rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
Last sitting: At-Tahiyyat, salawat, duas and salam

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The acts of worship in Ramadan are: fasting, muqabalah (reading the whole Qur’an together), sadaqat al-fitr and i‘tikaf (staying in the masjid for worship).
